# Google authentication button assets

Google Sans Medium 500, SIL Open Font License 1.1; license in OFL.txt. Official Google Fonts API serves a WOFF2 subset for “Đăng nhập bằng GoogleĐăng ký bằng Google”. Retrieved 2026-10-12:

- Font: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Google+Sans:wght@500&display=swap&text= (text parameter encodes the labels above).
- License: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/googlesans/OFL.txt.
- Current gradient G in `/images/google-g.png`: https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/g-logo.png; original pixels/proportions, embedded origin metadata.
- Branding: https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines. Logo remains a Google trademark, separate from the font license.

Assets are served locally. No Google SDK/font CDN/API request occurs on page load; the button initiates the server authorization redirect.
